audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart was a blanket 'Skill' on six rows while the content layer gives Cassiopeia levels 2-5 and both item stages.
audit.why: Twin Fang is a 0.75s cooldown for 40 mana with a heal attached; Miasma grounds for 24s down to 16s. Extended trades belong to her at every stage except your level 6.

audit.why: Level 6 is the only Malzahar row and it is right: Cassiopeia has no dash and Nether Grasp is point-and-click at 700 range, so it lands before Petrifying Gaze can turn.

edits.before: His poke pops your shield, your shove pops his tempo — the lane is a war between his range and your metronome.

edits.before: Out-shove his tempo, shield-manage his poke, and convert 6 into point-and-click kills. Shorthand: Miasma down, wave right, go.

edits.before: Cassiopeia wins by landing Miasma, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Cassiopeia wins by poisoning you on repeat and healing off Twin Fang faster than your visions can tick you back.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Short and out: E the wave, Q her only when she steps up to poison you, and leave before Twin Fang gets three ticks — extended trades are hers.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: Standing in poison to finish a trade — every Twin Fang on a poisoned target heals her, so the longer it runs the worse it gets.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your spell shield (Iron Boundary) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Miasma (W) is 24s at rank 1 and 16s maxed — it grounds, so Flash is your only exit inside it. - Twin Fang (E) is a 0.75s cooldown for 40 mana: never race it. - Petrifying Gaze (R) is 120/100/80s and only stuns you if you are facing her.

notes: I exceeded the two-report-entry guideline here (8 report edits) ONLY because lintFindings flagged those exact fields for misgendering; six of them are minimal pronoun substitutions, and report[3]/report[4] track the trade and wave fields they mirror. The packet flags that the chart gives Cassiopeia 5 of 7 stages while Malzahar wins 57.41%. I did not flip the chart: content win[] and packet.levelChart agree with each other and the kit supports them (Twin Fang 0.75s with a heal, Miasma grounding), so the win rate most likely comes from post-lane suppression value rather than lane stages. Recorded as a question rather than guessed. 'Iron Boundary' in breakdown.cooldowns was a fabricated ability name and is gone.
